analysis:

trades.entry_strategy: Limit order at $130 or better; willing to chase up to $132 on strength but no higher. Prefer entry on a flat to slightly down open that holds the SMA50 area.
trades.rationale: FUNDAMENTAL: CDW is a dominant IT products and solutions distributor with a 44% ROE, $884M FCF, and a forward P/E of 11.18 — the cheapest valuation among quality candidates on today's screened list. The fwd P/E discount to the market (~50%) is not justified by fundamentals; enterprise IT spending is recovering as post-COVID refresh cycles and AI infrastructure buildout drive hardware and software demand. EPS revisions are trending up +2.9% over 60 days. Revenue growth of 9.2% is accelerating. TECHNICAL: Price is at 39% of the 52-week range (lower half), confirmed UPTREND basing with SMA50 slope +2.1%. It is 4.7% above SMA50 (not extended) and only 3.9% below SMA200, meaning a SMA200 reclaim is a near-term catalyst. The basing structure at the $125-132 range represents a Stage 1-to-2 transition entry — exactly the risk/reward sweet spot the strategy targets. Next earnings Aug 5 (49 days) gives adequate time for the position to work before the next binary event.
trades.exit_plan: Hard stop at $119.62 (1.75x ATR below entry). Thesis-break conditions: (1) revenue growth decelerates below 5% or gross margins compress, signaling pricing power loss; (2) IT spending guidance cuts from major enterprise customers (watch MSFT, CSCO earnings); (3) price closes below SMA50 for 3 consecutive days on volume. Time stop: if no progress toward SMA200 ($135-140) within 60 days, reassess sizing. At target ($169), sell half and let remainder run toward LTCG if thesis remains intact.
